exposure: introduction of universal sonographic cervical length screening
cerclage indication (maternal history, ultrasound assessment, rescue)
outcome: proportion of cerclage based on indication
cohort: Two groups of women who underwent cervical cerclage before and after the introduction of universal sonographic cervical length screening.
finding: The introduction of universal cervical length screening increased the overall rate of cerclage and led to the most significant prolongation of pregnancy in low-risk women receiving ultrasound-indicated cerclage.
